title: Delete the verified ownership of a URL property
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete an advertiser account's verified ownership of a URL property (domain or URL prefix). To learn about the workflow for adding and verifying URL properties, refer to [Manage URL properties](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1769324038780930). > **Important**
> Starting October 15th, 2025, you need to also specify your developer app secret to be able to use this endpoint. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/property/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | app_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/apps) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |secret{Required}|string| Secret of your developer app.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | url_property_meta {Required} | object | Information about the URL property that you want to delete the verified ownership of.| #| property_type {Required} | integer | Type of the URL property.
Enum values：
  • 1: Domain.
  • 2: URL prefix.
| #| url {Required} | string | An owned URL that you want to delete the verified ownership of. Pass in the URL according to the `property_type` that you specify. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/property/delete/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "secret": "{{secret}}", "url_property_meta": { "property_type": {{property_type}}, "url": "{{url}}" } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.
Empty object (`{}`) for successful actions.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
